english: A committee of four persons is chosen at random from five married couples (ten persons). The probability that the committee contains at least two women and also contains at least one married couple is
hindi: पाँच विवाहित दम्पतियों (दस व्यक्तियों) में से चार व्यक्तियों की एक समिति यादृच्छया चुनी जाती है। समिति में कम से कम दो महिलाएँ होने तथा साथ ही कम से कम एक विवाहित दम्पति होने की प्रायिकता है
solution: Among these, no couple: $w$ women chosen, men only from the $5-w$ whose wives are absent
solution_full: Number of committees: $\binom{10}{4}=210$, all equally likely.
Committees with at least two women: with $w$ women and $4-w$ men, $\binom{5}{w}\binom{5}{4-w}$ ways. $w=2$: $10\cdot10=100$; $w=3$: $10\cdot5=50$; $w=4$: $5\cdot1=5$. Total $155$.

Complementary counting inside this set: count those with no married couple. If the $w$ women are fixed, a man may be chosen only if his wife is not among them, so the men come from the $5-w$ remaining husbands.
Hence committees with at least two women and at least one couple: $155-55=100$.
originality_note: New: a committee condition (at least two women) combined with a structural condition (contains a married couple) handled by complementary counting inside the first condition, then turned into a probability (way 5). Closest known: '4 persons from 6 couples: probability of no couple / exactly one couple'. Different because: the gender condition changes how many husbands are available, case by case, before the complement is taken.
blueprint_concepts: Committee and team formation with constraints
Probability computed using permutations and combinations

concept_use.Committee and team formation with constr: The committees are counted by cases on the number of women (2, 3, 4), and within each case the men are restricted by the no-couple condition.
concept_use.Probability computed using permutations: The probability is a ratio of combination counts: favourable committees 100 over all 210 committees.
